headline: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'
description: With an average temperature of 24.9°C across the country, July 2026 was the hottest month ever recorded in mainland France since measurements began in the early 20th century. The unprecedented heat was accompanied by an equally exceptional level of soil drought, Météo-France warned.

headline: Hyperonirism: 'I feel like my brain never stops at night'
description: 'Strange nights' (4/7). This little-known phenomenon is characterized by intense, continuous dreams, non-restorative sleep and daytime fatigue. It was first described by two American doctors in 1995.
